title: Delta evaluation pipeline for tool-invocation accuracy & argument validation
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Build a lightweight, automated delta-eval pipeline that runs whenever model/config changes are pushed to staging or production. The goal is to detect regressions in: 1) tool selection accuracy (is the model choosing the correct tool for a given prompt), and 2) argument/schema validation (are tool args formatted and populated correctly). This ticket covers the infra and integration work to run nightly and on-change checks, compute per-config baselines, and surface degradations to the Console + alerting system.

Scope:
- Ingest a curated golden prompt-suite (manual + synthetic adversarial cases) and a small held-out customer-like dataset.
- Run tool-invocation evaluation for each model/config variant triggered by the config-change webhook.
- Compute metrics (top-1 selection accuracy, top-3 accuracy, argument-schema pass rate, structured-arg F1, and confidence calibration drift).
- Persist delta against baseline for the specific model+quantization+kernel+routing policy.
- Implement deterministic gating rules for canary rollouts and publish findings to a dashboard and to the on-call alert path when thresholds breach.

Out of scope: automated remediation or rollback (separate rollout gating work).
acceptance_criteria: A pipeline trigger exists that runs on model/config change PR merge and nightly windows
Per-run report is stored in S3 with metadata (model, quantization, kernel, routing policy, commit SHA)
Metrics computed: top-1 selection accuracy, top-3 selection accuracy, arg-schema pass rate, arg-field F1, and confidence drift
A baseline computed from the last 'good' release is available and deltas are calculated per-config
Dashboard tile in Console showing trendlines and a 'delta view' that highlights regressions greater than configured thresholds
Alerting rule created: P0 alert if top-1 selection accuracy drops by >6% absolute vs baseline OR arg-schema pass rate < 95%
Synthetic arg-fuzzer included that tests edge cases for common tool schemas (dates, nested objects, missing fields)
PRD and runbook links included in the pipeline output and smoke test passes in CI
